correctedFailures.cause: Two material-only tests cleared the source morph table without updating the declared count. Corrected test fixtures preserve consistent counts.

New Demo preset asset routing used the old directory; applied-state validation also exposed r186 GLTFExporter skeleton-root hints invalid for multi-root PMX rigs. Corrected routing and added the reusable MMDVPDExporterPlugin.

limitations: No measured original-MMD equivalence; duplicate-entry summation and signed composition are project policies.
Native WebGPU requires an adapter; mandatory WebGL2 coverage remains.
Other morph families, ordered IK/append, physics, scene controls and representative fidelity remain overall work.

sourceReferences.inspected: Group morph record: referenced index and rate multiplication; group-of-group unsupported. Not original-MMD measurements.
Additive morph deltas precede skinning. Compiling weighted child deltas is an inference from core representation.
Weighted vertex-child compilation; silent unsupported-child omission is not inherited.
Relative POSITION targets. Tests execute npm Three.js 0.186.1, without claiming exact tag/package bytes.
processSkin picks bones[0] as optional skeleton hint. MMDVPDExporterPlugin omits invalid non-common-root hints; all 24 group exports validate.
